design_parameters.enrich_notes: Ohio EPA WQv uses 0.75 in precipitation (P) in WQv = C × 0.75 × A / 12; NPDES requires +20% WQv for sediment. General pond WQv drawdown cited as 24–48 hr; dry extended detention outlet explicitly 48 hr (<50% in first 16 hr); wet extended detention ED drawdown 24 hr (<50% in first 8 hr). Infiltration trench drain 24–48 hr (avoid >72 hr); soil K 0.5–2.5 in/hr; min 2 ft SHWT/bedrock below trench bottom (24 in). Bioretention min 40 hr drawdown (Ohio EPA); filter bed drain time 40 hr (1.66 days) in sizing; SHWT min 4 ft required (2 ft recommended); ponding generally <6 in, up to 12 in; media min 2.5 ft; min width 10 ft; L:W >2:1. Sand filter total drawdown 40 hr. Wetland pool depths 6–18 in (avg 6–12 in); wet pond permanent pool mean depth 3–6 ft (range only).
